Reasoning: Since the emitter is grounded, UCE is basically equal to the collector-to-ground voltage. It is known that the quiescent UCEQ=10V, while the power supply is 12V, so the voltage margin from the quiescent point to the cutoff end is about 12V-10V=2V; the margin to the saturation end is about 10V-0.2V=9.8V. The quiescent operating point is obviously closer to the cutoff end, so when the input amplitude gradually increases, it will first touch the cutoff region, and cutoff distortion will first appear.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify VCC=12 V and emitter grounded, so UCE is essentially the collector voltage. The text gives the quiescent UCEQ=10 V. Compare distance to cutoff: 12 V - 10 V = 2 V, versus distance to saturation: about 10 V - 0.2 V ≈ 9.8 V. Since the Q point is much closer to the cutoff end of the load line, increasing input amplitude will reach cutoff first; answer: cut-off distortion.

method.method_draft: Start by noting from the image that this is a collector-output common-emitter amplifier powered by +12 V. The text states UCEQ=10 V. For the input half-cycle that reduces base drive, UCE rises from 10 V toward the +12 V rail, so only about 2 V of upward collector swing is available before the transistor cuts off. For the opposite half-cycle, UCE would fall from 10 V toward saturation, leaving a much larger swing. Therefore the first clipped half-cycle is the cutoff side, so the first distortion is cut-off distortion.

推理：题目给出静态工作点 UCEQ = 10V。由于电源只有 12V，当输入的某个半周使基极驱动减小时，集电极电流减小，集电极电压升高，UCE 从 10V 向 +12V 上升；此方向只有约 12V - 10V = 2V 的摆幅余量，晶体管很快进入截止。相反，当输入另一个半周使基极驱动增大时，集电极电流增大，UCE 从 10V 向饱和压降方向下降，仍有接近 10V 的摆幅余量。因此随 ui 幅度增大，最先达到限制的是截止方向，首先出现截止失真。
